messages:
cheng: Quick heads-up: PR #5132 is blocking our deploy. I merged a KV prefix-caching change but nightly perf shows a spike on long-seq workloads.
cheng: Summary: baseline p95 token latency ~45ms -> patch p95 ~78ms, throughput down 1200 -> 900 req/s, resident mem +1.2GB on p4d nodes.
cheng: Repro steps I used:
```
./bench_tool --model rwd-v1 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --concurrency 16 --runs 5
```
cheng: Truncated sample output:
```
run 1: avg 52ms p95 78ms qps 910 mem_rss 42.1G
run 2: avg 50ms p95 76ms qps 930 mem_rss 41.9G
```
alice: Ack, I can take a look in ~20m. Do you have perf traces or counters?
cheng: Not full flamegraphs yet, but KV counters: `kv.cache.misses` jumped 1285 -> 4830 after the patch. Eviction events increased too.
ben: CI passed for unit/integration, but load test failed. Link?
cheng: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5132
sam: Pinging @alice and @ben for a quick perf review. If we don't have a fix fast we should canary the deploy to 10%.
sam: Note: reproduces only on long sequences (>1k tokens) under high concurrency. Short seqs are OK.
perf-bot: nightly-bench: redwood/longseq/17630: baseline p95=45.3ms -> patch p95=77.8ms (delta +72%).
ci-bot: Build #2398 succeeded. integration-tests: ok. e2e-slow: flaky (1 timeout).
alice: Skimming PR now — I suspect eviction path in `kv_cache::trim()`; extra locking added in the new path looks suspicious. I'll try a micro-optim and run local bench.
alice: Quick local tweak: removed a redundant mutex acquisition in trim (WIP). Running microbench...
alice: Local bench after tweak:
```
run a: avg 46ms p95 48ms qps 1180 mem_rss 40.1G
```
alice: This restores perf locally. I'll open a follow-up PR with the safer change. Meanwhile I recommend reverting #5132 on master and doing a canary with the revert + alice's follow-up later.
ben: +1 on revert for safety. Can someone cut the revert PR so infra can roll back quickly?
cheng: I will cut the revert PR now and trigger a canary.
sam: I notified infra to hold full rollout until canary completes. ETA ~30m.
perf-bot: canary-run: p95=47.2ms qps=1160 mem_rss=40.3G (canary cluster)
cheng: Canary metrics look good. Revert merged. I'll link follow-up PR when it's up.
sam: Thanks everyone — please paste follow-up PR and any postmortem notes here. Leaving thread open for remediation steps.
